envelope.command: verify source main heads and tests; export issues and repository state; create and verify six Git bundles; rewrite five source main histories under directory prefixes with git-filter-repo 2.47.0; merge unrelated histories; normalize one root environment and doctrine; run full staging and fresh-clone checks; rename the archived personal legacy repository; create private tannerpolley/ePC-SAFT with Actions disabled; push main and engine/v0.2.0.dev0; recreate nine issues and preserve comments; replace the canonical local path recoverably; archive five source repositories

user_approval.source: explicit Codex task request on 2026-08-05 to execute the full Phase 1-10 migration plan with supervised GPT-5.6 Luna Max agents

observations.name: history_preservation
observations.expected: All five source main histories remain reachable under their owned monorepo directories with exact pre-normalization subtree trees.
observations.observed: Governance, Engine, Data, Validation, and Lab filtered heads are ancestors of the destination head; all five imported subtree tree hashes exactly matched their source main trees; git fsck --full passed; the integrated history contained 394 pre-normalization commits and namespaced the Engine tag as engine/v0.2.0.dev0.

observations.name: root_environment
observations.expected: One worktree-relative Codex environment builds and installs exactly one non-editable epcsaft wheel containing EOS, Equilibrium, and Regression.
observations.observed: Fresh-clone and canonical-path setup installed only epcsaft 0.2.0.dev0 from build/environment-wheel. Split and editable distributions were absent, and sanitizer wheel/venv state was removed after validation.

observations.name: scientific_and_readiness_validation
observations.expected: Retained numerical evidence, campaigns, packets, native quality, sanitizer checks, and Governance readiness pass from the unified root.
observations.observed: Engine: 123 passed and 6 deselected; mypy: 28 source files clean; selected Ruff gate: clean; Validation: 4 fast and 6 campaign tests passed; Lab: 51 oracle tests passed; sanitizer: 8 passed; Data packet inventory: 14 versions clean; Khudaida and Figiel vertical slices passed; clang-tidy/native build, management preflight, artifact-store check, Git fsck, JSON/TOML/shell syntax, and cleanup audits passed.

observations.name: review_remediation
observations.expected: Independent reviewers find no unresolved material migration defect.
observations.observed: Review findings were remediated by detecting staged/untracked affected paths, avoiding unnecessary campaigns, cleaning sanitizer artifacts, validating receipt integrity and ownership manifests, rejecting nested workflows, and binding archive-member hashes. Tampered receipt, ownership drift, nested workflow, and wrong member digest probes were all rejected.

record.retry: No migration retry is pending. Any restoration, source unarchive, visibility change, namespace change, or topology reversal requires a new exact operation record.
stop_conditions: Destination main diverges from the canonical local main or gains another active package identity.
A source repository is unarchived and treated as active authority without a new doctrine decision.
A nested Git root, subtree Codex environment, CI/CD workflow, mutable sibling install, or legacy split distribution is introduced.
Bundle, commit-map, issue-export, source-manifest, artifact-store, or backup evidence becomes unavailable or fails its recorded integrity check.
record.reversibility: Source repositories can be unarchived, the former local parent can be restored from the timestamped backup, and source histories can be reconstructed from verified bundles and commit maps. Destination issues can be reopened or remapped through a separately recorded operation.
irreversible_effects: Creating repository ID 1324553602 at tannerpolley/ePC-SAFT displaced GitHub's old-name redirect from the public legacy repository; that historical repository remains available as archived tannerpolley/ePC-SAFT-legacy with repository ID 1205291036.
